dpa.text:
This variable determines how the opponent will react to your punches.

The first five digits represent how the opponent reacts to a specific type of punch.

Digit 1: left highpunch defense
Digit 2: right highpunch defense
Digit 3: left body blow defense
Digit 4: right body blow defense
Digit 5: star punch defense

Then. the defense values are as follows:
0 = hit
1 = hit + star
2 = IKD
3 = IKD (IKO if hit with 3 stars)
4 = block
5 = miss

7= cancel stun

Sometimes, like in King Hippo's case, a 6 will be used to represent that the opponent will change his defense.

==EXAMPLE==
If the Opponent Defense variable is set to 44112, he will block left and right highpunches, will grant you a star if you attack with a left or right body blow, and will be knocked down if you hit him with a star.
